verdict_text: YES. The script builds a fresh output dict, so renumbering cannot collide; it drops every tensor of blocks 2, 6, 10, 14, maps surviving blocks 0,1,3,4,5,7,8,9,11,12,13,15 onto 0..11 in order, passes non-block tensors through untouched, and preserves values, shapes and dtypes. The two asserts (layer index set is exactly {0..11}, which also rules out any block 12..15 remaining, and exactly 86 tensors) run before the save, so a failure exits non-zero with no output written. Output is a single `out/T1/model.safetensors`.
